items.description: Send and receive faxes directly to and from a Google Docs account with InterFAX. Send faxes by simply clicking a bookmarklet; receive faxes directly into your Google Docs folder. Logging on to the InterFAX control panel is not even necessary.
Uses the InterFAX SendfaxEx method to send a binary file such as Microsoft Word or Acrobat PDF to any fax number.
